CustomField.description: ALF-RS-08 FR13: derived, not rep-editable. AF_RequiredDocumentService.recomputeCompleteness() sets this from the reservation's own AF_RequiredDocument__c child rows (seeded per AF_RequiredDocumentType__mdt: Quotation, Payment Receipt where deposit, Customer ID, Approval Reference, Vehicle Stock/VIN, Trade-In Appraisal where applicable) - true only once every seeded row is Linked or Waived. AF_VR_RequiredDocumentsNotManuallySet blocks a direct edit to this field outside that recompute.
CustomField.label: Required Documents Complete?
